**Doin Time.** We know what you've been doing. You've been throwing the pets. T0@$TY across the room, C1iPPY off the wall, over and over, and they've been counting. So now there's a line. Throw a pet ten times inside one minute and the sirens go off, the screen says **BUSTED!**, your pet vanishes in a puff of smoke, and an iron ball drops out of the sky with a CLANK. Squachy is in **STRIPES**, number 1337, chained to it by the ankle for the next ten minutes. The ball has a face. The ball has opinions.

<p align="center"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skizzophrenic/SquachWatch-CYD/v1.33.0/docs/doin-time.gif" width="480" alt="Red and blue siren bars flash at the top and bottom of the screen and BUSTED! appears in yellow over Squachy, who is suddenly in black and white prison stripes with a 1337 number patch. An iron ball with an angry little face sits chained to his right ankle and says You threw a pet. Now you've got me. Squachy says I was framed. By a toaster. He is thrown upward, the chain snaps taut a third of the way up and he drops back as the ball says Where do you think you're going. A small amber clock reading 9:53 hangs over the ball. Later, out of the stripes, Squachy stands with the same ball still chained to him as a pet; it says You chose me. Over a toaster. Bold. The Settings PET row reads BALL AND CHAIN."></p>

**The cell block.** Ten minutes, and the clock is right there over the ball so you can watch it. The pet you threw is in protective custody until it's up. Settings won't let you change the outfit or the pet while he serves, just tells you how long is left. Throw Squachy and the chain stops him about a third of the way up ("Nope." "Where do you think you're going?" "Sit."). Try to wander off and it stops that too. The ball checks in about once a minute ("Your pet filed a report. It was mostly crying." / "Some people collect stamps. You collect charges.") and Squachy answers back ("I was framed. By a toaster."). Poke the ball and it writes that down as well. The sentence survives a restart, so don't bother. When it's up, the ball says its goodbye and goes up in smoke, your pet comes back, and Squachy keeps the stripes as an outfit, because he looked good in them.

**Ball & Chain, the pet.** Serve one whole sentence and the ball becomes a pet you can pick, same as the others. Settings > PET > BALL & CHAIN. He sits chained to Squachy's ankle, no stripes this time, with a dozen new things to say about the arrangement ("The only pet you can't throw. Think about that." / "I don't fetch. I anchor." / "Not a ball and chain. A commitment."), three replies to being poked ("Pet. Not poke. Pet."), and three for when the chain stops a throw ("Leash law."). Squachy, for his part: "We're not friends. We're attached." The chain is as short as it was in jail. That's the deal.

**Updates that say what went wrong.** A lot of you have seen "couldn't reach squachwatch.com" and had nothing to go on. The board now does its own fetching, and when something's in the way it tells you which thing: a hotel or school WiFi that wants a sign-in first, a network that blocks the site, a router that can't look up the name (the board now tries the site's fixed addresses instead), the site itself being slow or down, or a secure-only redirect. It retries a few times before giving up, and every message ends with a short code in brackets you can quote if you ask for help. One honest note: this fix lives on the board, so a board that can't reach the site today still can't reach it to fetch this release. If yours is stuck, one USB install from the flasher gets you onto the new code, and WiFi updates after that use it.

**And the diet.** We found about 70 KB of flash nobody was using. The compiler was carrying crash-unwinding tables for a feature the firmware never used, hundreds of colours were being worked out every frame instead of written down once, the update code was dragging a general-purpose web library around for three small fetches, and the pets had some duplicate drawing code. All gone, with the same pixels on the screen. The 3.2" board went from about 205 KB free to about 280 KB, and every other board gained about the same. That's six or seven more cell-block-sized features of room.

### The actually-useful part

**Added**
- The cell block: ten pet throws inside a minute is ten minutes in STRIPES, chained to an iron ball with a face. Sirens, BUSTED!, a puff, the CLANK, fifteen lines from the ball, four from Squachy, yank lines when the chain stops a throw, poke replies, and a goodbye. The time left shows over the ball, and on the Settings OUTFIT and PET rows. The sentence survives a restart.
- STRIPES, outfit 20, kept once a sentence is served.
- BALL & CHAIN, a pet earned by serving a whole sentence: chained to the ankle, with his own dozen lines, poke replies and yank lines, and Squachy's answers. The master unlock gives him too.
- WiFi updates: failures now say whether the network wants a sign-in, blocks the site, can't look the name up, or the site is slow, down or secure-only, each with a short code. The site is also reached by its fixed addresses when the router's name lookup fails, and fetches retry up to three times.
- Console `JAIL`, `FREE`, `BALL` and `PET` for the bench; emulator `--pet 5` and `SQUACHSIM_JAIL=1|2`.

**Changed**
- About 70 KB of flash back on every board: no C++ exception tables, fixed colours as constants, our own small fetch instead of the HTTP library, and slimmer pet drawing. Same pixels.
- Chained to the ball, Squachy's wander stops at the end of the chain, and so does a startled dart.
- The squad's outfit list grows to twenty for STRIPES.

**Fixed**
- The WiFi update check at boot could run past its time budget on a slow network; it stays inside it now.
